claims.rationale: The forced pass was always implicit in the code (src/exp6_solve.zig:926-929 emits the pass edge unconditionally) but unstated in AXIOMS.md. Written as A6 in §2 block A with a claim ID. Depends on A5 (pass always legal). The artifact records 516,242 terminal-bit states at 4×4 where a side cannot place (build T184).

In the brief's mandated order: AGENTS.md (already in project context), docs/infra/delegation/DELEGATEE.md (§'Your context is fresh', §'Commit through the wrapper'), docs/epic-01-markovian/AXIOMS.md (all seven sections, especially §2's A-block and §7's amendment log), docs/evidence/ORACLE-V2/incompleteness-T266.md (full file, 500+ lines). === (2) WHAT I CONCLUDED AND ON WHAT EVIDENCE ===

C1 — The forced pass is an unwritten axiom. The code at src/exp6_solve.zig:926-929 emits the pass edge unconditionally, clearing ko and incrementing passes. A player with no legal placement therefore gets a forced pass that is indistinguishable from a voluntary one. AXIOMS.md §2's A5 stated only that pass is always legal; it did not state that a player unable to place MUST pass, or that such a forced pass counts toward termination. This is a rules choice other rulesets make differently. The axiom is now written as A6.

C2 — The 516,242 terminal-bit count is correctly cited. Source: build-T184-2026-08-01.stdout:162 ('terminal flags set: 516242'), cross-referenced against build-T184-2026-08-01.md line 37.

C3 — The census seeds only the empty goban. The code at src/exp6_solve.zig:964-969 seeds (empty, Black, KO_NONE, 0) and (empty, White, KO_NONE, 0). There is no mechanism for handicap stones or arbitrary-start positions. This was a decided exclusion — the model solves the complete game from the natural fresh-start root — but was not stated explicitly. Now stated in AXIOMS.md §6 as an explicit scope boundary.

C4 — The terminology sweep ('monochrome' → 'single-colour goban') was applied to all prose instances in: (a) docs/evidence/ORACLE-V2/incompleteness-T266.md — 17 prose instances replaced; two calibration check identifiers (K2-monochrome-law, CB2_monochrome_law) left untouched as code references to the Python scanner. A terminology note added at top. (b) CLAIMS.md — three rows edited: CODE.WZO2-INCOMPLETE (3 instances), CODE.WZO2-PASS1-LAW (5 instances, including row title), CODE.GTP-LHSIDE (2 instances). Each row carries a parenthetical noting the term was superseded per glossary. The findings file findings/T266-incompleteness.json is immutable (absorbed by T279) and retains the old term per policy.

C5 — Claimlint floor preserved: rows=309 (was 308), C1a=10, C1b=0, C2=14, C6=0, C7=2, calibration PASS. One new row added (GLOBAL.AXIOM-FORCEDPASS), zero regressions. The new row is not an orphan — it depends on GLOBAL.AXIOM-PASS (d: edge).

The build output line reads 'terminal flags set: 516242' with no further qualification, and the T266 derivation (F1–F3) establishes that terminal = 'this side has no legal goban moves from this position.'

A2 — That claimlint C6 scans AXIOMS.md for [TAG:STATUS] cite-tags but not for bare file paths. I did not verify this by introducing a synthetic cite-tag and running claimlint; the brief says 'C6 now scans AXIOMS.md as well as PROGRESS.md' and I assumed the cite-tag syntax is the trigger.

A3 — That the DELEGATEE.md 'one writer per file' rule applies to CLAIMS.md while I am editing three rows. The brief explicitly scoped these rows as my deliverable, and the one-writer rule is about engine source files (src/retro.zig, oracle.zig, rules.zig, solve.zig). CLAIMS.md is a register, not an engine file.

A4 — That the 'monochrome-black' / 'monochrome-white' in the table headers of incompleteness-T266.md (line 104) should be changed to 'single-colour-black' / 'single-colour-white' — these are column headers in a table of measurement results, and the glossary term is 'single-colour goban'. The compound form 'single-colour-black group' = 'a group (goban) that is single-colour and black' seems consistent with the glossary definition.
